dialogues.speaker: Komaki
dialogues.text: Thanks to your help, it's growing very well...

dialogues.speaker: Komaki
dialogues.text: But I think that it will need some rest before it can regain its efficacy again, haha...

dialogues.speaker: Komaki
dialogues.text: It is a fine year, and wishes in the waters have been very rich indeed. I believe that they will only get better...
